name: Select
purpose: Presents a list of options in a collapsible menu that is keyboard and screen-reader accessible.
scenarios: Choose a country or language from a long list
Select a status in a form

options.description: Array of option objects with value and label.

placeholder.description: Text shown when no option is selected.

antiPatterns: Do not use a select for only two options; consider a radio group.
Do not remove the visible label.

a11y.focus: Trigger is focusable; focus moves into the listbox when opened.
a11y.labeling: Visible label is associated with the combobox.

responsive.strategy: The trigger stretches to the parent inline size. The listbox is positioned absolutely and stays within the viewport.

breakpoints.compact: Full inline size of the parent; listbox uses available space.

rtl.strategy: Logical CSS only. Direction inherits from document lang/dir; listbox opens in the flow direction.
